title: AidPage Atlas — rule-based, rank-free multi-lens profiles of Korean municipalities (v1.4.1) with national aid thresholds and recorded outcomes
description: Rule-based typology of 256 Korean municipal units (si/gun/gu): natural hazards (flood history, landslide/slope, coastal contact, drought zones), a social hazard (traffic), unordered vulnerability traits, and ordinance holdings. National top-quartile thresholds within the same unit class; no composite score or ranking. v1.4 adds the national recovery-aid threshold layer (fiscal-capacity bands, Regulation art. 5①, in force 2024-11-19) and recorded outcomes from the Disaster Yearbook 2012–2024. v1.4.1 (2026-09-17) restores Jeongeup-si (52180), which was missing from v1.4 (255 units); merged-unit specification is now 230. Sensitivity specifications (p70/p80, 230 units) shipped for review. Files: data/ref/sgg_types.json, sgg_threshold.json, sgg_type_specs.json, sgg_ordin.json; viewer: atlas.html.
